title: Sindhu, Sen Secure Historic Indian Double at Hylo Open
indian_angle: This marks a rare occasion where two Indian shuttlers claimed titles at the same international event, highlighting India's growing prowess.
summary: PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen both won their respective finals in straight games at the Hylo Open in Saarbrucken, Germany, achieving a memorable double for Indian badminton.

title: Prannoy Heads Indian Charge at Korea Open; Sen Withdraws
indian_angle: HS Prannoy will now lead India's contingent at the Korea Open, while Lakshya Sen's withdrawal is a notable development for Indian fans following his recent Hylo Open victory.
summary: HS Prannoy is set to lead the Indian challenge at the Korea Open, with Lakshya Sen pulling out of the tournament after his recent title triumph in Germany, where he was scheduled to face Dong Tian Yao.

title: Tenders Released for Khelo India Youth Games 2026
indian_angle: The release of tenders signals the beginning of preparations for a major domestic multi-sport event that provides a crucial platform for young Indian badminton talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released tenders for the upcoming Khelo India Youth Games 2026, indicating the start of organizational activities for the national event.

title: Junior World Championships 2026 Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's brightest young talents for the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships, aiming to nurture future champions.
summary: A national coaching camp is being held at the National Centre of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati to prepare Indian junior shuttlers for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of this committee provides Indian badminton players with a formal voice in the sport's governance, ensuring their concerns and perspectives are heard.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at enhancing player representation and welfare within the sport's administration.
